paper.textual_conclusion: The accuracy is 100% on the Argentine LSA64 dataset, and the experimental results show that the model in this paper has the advantages of fewer model parameters, smaller operations, and higher accuracy in sign language recognition compared with traditional 3D convolutional networks and long–short term memory, which effectively saves computational cost and time cost.

guesses.detail: Use timm 1.0.22 skresnext50_32x4d, the grouped model equivalent to the original SKNet-50 reference, with random initialization, 224-square input, max spatial pooling and Mish. Its size is not chosen to match 12.34M parameters or 62.50 GFLOPs. This is not the missing author architecture.

Use the cited pinned TCN TemporalBlock three times: width 256, kernel 3, sawtooth block dilations 1/2/5 and dropout 0.2. Mish replaces ReLU as described in the paper. Temporal max pooling feeds a 64-class classifier.

Bilinear resize to 224-square RGB; mean absolute grayscale frame differences; three-frame moving average; select the strongest 32 local maxima in chronological order. Fill shortages uniformly, then repeat the last frame if the video has fewer than 32 frames. Smoothing, resizing and filling are declared interpretations.

Seed 42 per-class 60/20/20 split gives 1,920/640/640 videos. Ranger at learning rate 0.0001 uses library defaults. Interpret 1,000 iterations as optimizer steps, with effective batch 128 accumulated over 32 microbatches of four videos. BatchNorm sees 128 frames per microbatch, an explicit protocol deviation. Validation every 50 steps selects the earliest best checkpoint.

All new architecture and training outputs are conditional evidence, never comparable target values regardless of numerical closeness. Execution choices are resolved; the exact author architecture and historical comparison provenance remain unknown.

Validate every 50 steps. Atomically save training state every 60 steps (four complete training epochs), and at termination. Embed the selected best model in the resume state so an interrupted later checkpoint cannot be reused accidentally. Seven exact-effective-batch preflight steps exercise Ranger Lookahead synchronization at step six, followed by state reload and another optimizer step.

Scale RGB to [0,1] and normalize with ImageNet means (0.485,0.456,0.406) and standard deviations (0.229,0.224,0.225), without pretrained weights.
